title: Just Another Night Shift
description:
Just Another Night Shift is a casual competitive 1v1 and 2v2 PvP multiplayer online game.

 You get to play as a security guard and a thief. The Thief’s objective is to steal a specific item from the mansion, while the Guard tries to stop him. Join us for hours of fun gameplay with your friends! 

Basics Of the Game

• The winner of the game is whoever wins the set amount of rounds first.

• Players switch sides at the middle of the game.

• Both characters have strengths and weaknesses, and a special ability.

• The Guard has additional tasks. If he fails to do the tasks on time, the Thief will win the round. 

Sneak into the mansion and steal the valuable! Buy useful items from the black market, use the Thiefs agility and special hiding ability to avoid the Guard and win the game. 

Guard the mansion and catch the Thief! Use the dog or the cameras to gain advantage over the Thief. Remember to do the tasks, light the shadows with the flashlight and buy helpful items from the security shop.

 

Try your skills at a more compact modern mansion or jump to an old castle like mansion with room to play! Find the best strategies and routes on both maps and see who will be victorious! 

Attention! 

The game works using a peer-to-peer (P2P) system. Player 1 works as a server and the player 2 as a client. Over long distances between these two you may expect high latency and problems in the game.
description_short: Just Another Night Shift is a casual competitive 1v1 or 2v2 PvP stealth strategy game. Play as a Thief and as a Security Guard. Steal the valuable and try to prevent it in this 3D indie game. Grab a friend and work THE NIGHT SHIFT of your life. Join us for hours of fun gameplay with your friends!
